meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Hides Stack Overflow's sidebar promos; Hot Network Questions, footer; dim/blur/hide counters, excerpts, askers
meta.notes:
Checked 2026-11-13, logged out, real Chrome (headless): iPhone UA 390x844 and desktop UA on stackoverflow.com/questions (Newest Questions list); plain curl was blocked (403) so the rendered DOM was used. Fixtures `real.html` and `desktop-real.html` are sanitised excerpts (text stripped, needed ancestors only, `data-keep` on the main column, the question list and the Log in link).

LIVE (same on phone and desktop): `.js-zone-container` 6 (3 native-question and 3 sidebar ad containers, empty without an ad network), `#hot-network-questions` 1, `aside.s-sidebarwidget:has(a[href^="https://agents.stackoverflow.com"])` 1 (Stack Overflow for Agents), `#sidebar .s-sidebarwidget__yellow` 1 (The Overflow Blog), `#sidebar .js-join-leave-container` 1 (Collectives), `.s-post-summary--stats` 15, `.s-post-summary--content-excerpt` 15, `.s-post-summary--meta .s-user-card` 15, `#footer` 1, `#onetrust-consent-sdk` 1 and `#onetrust-banner-sdk` 1 (original cookie rule). The original ad and app-banner rules matched nothing other than the new ad zones.

Choices: Votes, answers and views Show/Dim/Hide; Question excerpts and Asker names and avatars Show/Blur/Hide. All classes are Stacks design-system names (`s-post-summary`, `s-sidebarwidget`, `s-user-card`), not hashed.

SOURCE: uBlock users hide `#hot-network-questions`, the sidebar Blog widget and `#js-gdpr-consent-banner` (Stack Exchange meta answer, a Hacker News thread, the mig4ng and remcycles lists); the GDPR banner id matched nothing in this region.

NOT verified: question pages (answers, comments, the related-questions column), the signed-in layout, the left navigation column, tag pages.
